Hi, what's wrong?\n...Want to know about Estagia?
It's a world in another dimension and...\nNot that? What's going on in the world?
Well, there're various seasonal festivals in your\nworld, right?
Seasonal festivals are held in other worlds just\nthe same as you guys do.
But festivals may lose their true meanings as\ntime goes by. They may disappear or become\nsomething like a party.
Estagia is watching and maintaining the seasonal\nfestivals so they won't be disordered or decline.
Estagia has a group of knights in each region and\nthey're watching seasonal festivals in various\nworlds. Navida is in charge of Xmas.
The Xmas Knights led by Sir Agios have saved\nXmas in many worlds.\nThey're cool, aren't they?
Me? I became an apprentice knight recently, so\nI had to stay here.
Then, it was split apart from the city by the\nearthquake. And we are floating between the time\nand space...
You can redo Xmas quests\nafter completing them.

Welcome to Navida's Relics!\nSo, you came to help me out right?\nHey, come over here.
Huh? Questions? ...Oh, right.\nThat might have caused a loss of memory.\nOkay. Ask me anything.
We met... somewhere?
Where am I?
What are you doing here?
[ffff64]What do you want me to do for you?[ffffff]
Oh? Is this the first time to come here?\nOh, my bad. Then, I should have introduced myself\nat first.
I'm Nicola. I belong to Hagios' platoon in\nXmas Knights. I'm an apprentice knight.\nNice to meet you.
So... Welcome to Navida's Relics!\n...Well, no one is here except me though.
Oh, sorry, sorry. You're here.\nI didn't forget you. Calm down.
I call this place Navida's Relics.\nIt used to be a part of a square in Navida City\nin the world called Estagia.
And an earthquake attacked the world and it was\nsplit apart from the city...
We were here at that time and we are stranded\nlike this.
That means... I'm in another world?!
That's right.\nNavida's Relics are in another dimension.
It's like a... floating island between time and\nspace.
When it touches another world, a hole that you\ncame through appears...
How does it move between time and space?\nHow should I know?
What are you doing, huh? I'm struggling to live.\nYou won't see how hard it is...\nThere's no food and necessities...
But a weird wormhole appears and I can go to\nanother world through it. So, we go get what\nwe need in turns. Right, boy?
She had a lot of troubles in the tough situation.\nThey won't be able to go back to their world...?
A way to go back to Estagia? Yes, there is.\nSir Agios told me when we were miraculously\nconnected with magic.
Wake the sleeping spirit underground and borrow\nthe power. I heard all the things we need to do.
We succeeded in waking the spirit several times\nbut we couldn't go back because we couldn't\ncollect enough things...
It's really hard to collect all of them with only\nthe two of us. And even if we collect them,\nmonsters come to here and steal them...
Huh? ...Oh, right. I need to wake the spirit again\nto go back to Estagia, so could you help us out?
Thanks! That makes it easy!\nOkay, let's get started.
To wake the spirit, we need to borrow the power\nof sacred dragons. So, we need to summon them\nat first.
We offer chicken and Stollen and...\nHuh? Haven't you heard of Stollen?\nIt's a... kind of fruit cake for Xmas.
You guys don't make Stollen in Xmas?\n...Oh. I see...\nSo, it's not famous in your world...
Okay, I'll write down the ingredients and recipe.\nAnd ask someone who is good at making cakes\nafter collecting them. Oh, don't forget chicken.
Now you know the ingredients of Stollen but...\nWho's good at making cakes...?\nLet's go ask someone in [ffff64]Sofya City[ffffff].
Hey! How did it go?\nWhoa?! How did you get such amount of chicken?
And what about Stollen? ...Let me see.\n...Great! Looks so delicious!\nThanks. This is for you.
There are many places to hang stockings.\nJust try it, And you'll get wonderful gifts on\nthe next day. Wait until you see them!
You can hang up to 5 [ffff64]Xmas Stockings[ffffff]\nat Navida's Relics ([64ffff]Current Map[ffffff]).
Check the stockings [ffff64]the next day[ffffff] and you may\nfind gifts in them!
Please check News for the details of the event.
Okay, put it here and...
Who called us?
Hi! It's me!
You are so facetious as always...\nWell, it must have been hard to summon us...
But you will pay for this if you've summoned us\nfor foolish errands. Why did you call us?
It's not foolish at all.\nI just want to talk about how to move this place\nto Navida City in Estagia.
So, I want you guys to wake the spirit.
To talk with the spirit?!\nWho do you think you are...?!
Wait, look around.\nThe situation has become serious...
Hmm, right... I can't feel any energy around here.\nNo wonder she needs the help of the great spirit.
Hm, very well. But as you know, you need the\nornament to contact the spirit.
It's alright!\nThis adventurer can get it. Right?
Is that okay with you? ...Okay. Thank you.\nThe offering that you need to contact the great\nspirit is called Wreath, which is made of plants.
It's used for Xmas ornament in various worlds, so\nit should be easy to get it.
Call us again when you get the wreath.\nWe'll be waiting for you.
Umm... There's no Xmas in your world, right?\nSo, you don't know how to...
Alright, alright. I'll write down how to make\nthe wreath. Just collect the materials and\nask a dexterous person.
Who is the right person to ask...?\nLet's find a dexterous person in [ffff64]Sofya City[ffffff]!
Welcome back. Did you find someone?\n...Wow, great. It's very nice.
Must be used to make ornaments like this.\nI guess only a pure-hearted person can make such\nan elaborate wreath...
Thanks. This is for you.
Now, let's wake the spirit.
Come on, dragons!\nWe've got the wreath!
Gah! Watch your mouth!\nWho do you think we are?!
She's a mere child.\nWe need to send her back to Estagia so she can\nlearn manners.
Right. Let's begin.\nAre you all set?
Sure!
The sleeping spirit...\nListen to our prayer...\nHear our voices and wake up...!
We appreciate your kindness.\nPlease forgive us for disturbing your sleep...
No worries. I'm the one who should say thank you.\nI've been worrying about this place.\nIt's still far away from Estagia.
I understand...
Hey, spirit. Why can't you move this place?\nGet us back to Estagia!
How rude you are!\nYou are in front of the great spirit!\nDon't you see that?!
It's alright. I can stay as I am now because\nshe's collecting many offerings from other worlds.
Hmm, I just don't understand it.\nThis thoughtless girl and strange animal are\nprotecting the spirit and this place...?
Thoughtless? Strange? That's rude, isn't it?
...Well, this place itself has not got enough\nenergy to go back to Estagia.
Aww! Then, how much energy do we need?\nYou don't have enough power either?
H-Hey! Stop being...
This is a small place but tremendous energy is\nrequired to move it between time and space...\nDon't push it.
We have no choice but to collect the same energy\nas the earth of Navida has...
If we fill this place with the plants related to\nXmas, they might supply energy to this place...
I'm sorry for asking you too many things but...\nCan you help us out? Please!
We also need your help.\nWe want to send the spirit and these two kids\nto Estagia right now.
I appreciate your help.\nI'll tell you the plants I need.\nPlease remember them all...
Okay?\nThanks in advance.
But where are those plants...?\n[ffff64]Lefina[ffffff] is good at making flower ornaments, so\n[ffff64]let's go ask her[ffffff]...
Looks like it was difficult to find all of them.\nBut now we can collect the energy.\nThanks for your help and this is for you.
Hey, spirit! We've got the plants!\nCheck it out!
Hey!! How many times do I have to tell you?!
It's alright... Thank you. I'll try to move this\nplace with the energy of these plants...
There's enough energy to move but it won't move...\nSo, it can be...
What happened?!
If this place has enough energy and it's near\nNavida City in Estagia...
This place will be pulled by the earth of Navida.\nBut it's not moving. That means...
That means?
This place is drifting too far from Navida...
So, we still need more energy and it's drifting\nfar away from Navida. That's terrible.
Do you really understand the situation?\nThe situation is very serious, you know?
I know. I thought something like this would\nhappen. I've collected Xmas Stars!
What?! Xmas Stars?!
Oh, that's!!
Xmas Stars sparkle in any world as long as\nXmas is held...
Xmas Knights find their way using the stars and\ngo investigate Xmas in other worlds... When they\ngo back, they navigate by the Xmas Stars...
Right, Xmas starlight shows the direction\nof Navida... So, if the great spirit can move\nthis place to that direction...
That's a good idea! Hey, girl!\nWhere are the Xmas stars you've collected?
Oh! Xmas Stars!!\nW-Which is the right direction?!
The light is weak... A lot of Xmas Stars exist\nin the world where Xmas is held. They should\nemit strong light enough for Xmas Knights to use.
T-That's right.\nHey, where are the other Xmas Stars...?
I'll bring them! Wait a minute!
What's going on?!
W-What happened?!
They got me...\nThe stars are gone...
When the hole appeared, many monsters came into\nhere. And I desperately drove them away but...
Looks like they scattered through the wormhole and\nthe monsters took them...
What the...
Umm...
I heard from Nicola that you're an adventurer\nof the world beyond the wormhole...
I know you've helped Nicola many times, so\nit goes against my conscience for asking you\nsuch a thing but...
Could you collect the Xmas Stars in your world,\nplease?
I appreciate your help...\nI'm not sure how many stars we need but...\nCould you collect [ffff64]3 stars[ffffff] for now?
It's my fault!\nI'm sorry for asking you so many favors.
You can get [ffff64]Xmas Stars[ffffff] by defeating monsters.
You can get them from any monsters, however,\nthe boss monsters are more likely to drop them.
Thanks! You've collected them already!\nYou've been a great help.\nThis is for you.
I'm sorry for asking too much.\nThank you for collecting Xmas Stars.
Can you see the right direction to Navida?
I'll try it...
Hmm, even 3 stars aren't enough...\nThe starlight is still weak to find it out...
Oh, no...
Cheer up, Nicola.\nI found a fact...
What?
The starlight is not strong enough but it's\nshowing one direction.
If we get more Xmas Stars, the starlight will get\nstronger and...
!! And it leads to Navida!\nWe only have to collect 'em!
We need to collect Xmas Stars and prepare to\nmove this place at the same time...
Nicola, could you help me out to prepare?
Sure!\nBut what about the stars?
We shouldn't rely too much on the adventurer...
Pom?!\n(What?!)
It's just the same as you did with Nicola.\nYou can do it, right?
P-Pom!!\n(Y-Yes!!)
We couldn't have done it without you.\nI owe everything to you.
Can you help him collect the stars when you are\nfree?
Thanks. Then, everytime you collect [ffff64]30 stars[ffffff],\ncome to here and give them to him.
I'll tell him to give you something in return.\nThanks!
[ff6464]Xmas Event has ended.[ffffff]
Pom pom, pom pom?\n(Have you collected Xmas Stars?)
Pom pom pom. Pomoo.\n(If you've collected them, please hand them over\nto me. Thanks in advance.)
Pomoo. Pom pom, pom pom!\n(Thanks. If you get more, come to me!)

Oh, it's you!
Actually, we've finally found the way to move\nthis place. You've been a great help to us, so\nI really wanted to show it to you.
C'mon, spirits! The adventurer's here!\nIt's time to move here to Navida, right?
Shush! How disgraceful!!\nHow many times do I have to tell you to watch\nyour mouth against the great spirit!
It's okay.\nI'm also excited to go back to Navida...
...Finally we can go back to Navida.\nI owe everything to you.
Now, please watch this.\nYour efforts realized this miracle!
Whoa?! W-What's that?!
Seems like it clashed with another world again...
What?! T-Then, new monsters might be coming into\nhere! Everyone, stay alert!!
S-Sir Agios!!
Sir! Sir Agios! Get hold of yourself!!\nWhy did you come out from the wormhole??!
Ug... Ugh... You're...! Nicola... Novice Nicola?!\nWhy aren't you in Navida...?
It's been a while, Agios.\nWhat happened? You're seriously injured.
!! Oh, the Great Spirit!\nSo, is it Navida here? Answer me, Nicola!\nAm I back to Navida?!
What? Um ah... It's Navida but to be more\naccurate, it's not really Navida...
This place is a part of Navida and it's floating\nbetween time and space for some reason.
I'll explain about this later, so could you\ntell me what happened to you and your knights\nfirst?
...We Xmas Knights finally found the felon,\nInzanio the Dark Knight, who have been ruining\nXmas in many worlds, and chasing after him...
Since he ran into the world in which Xmas doesn't\nexist, me and our knights couldn't supply energy\nand got weak in the blink of an eye.
Inzanio the Dark Knight took advantage of it and\ncaptured the knights except me and sealed them\nsomewhere...
What?!
What?!
What the...
...Three people of another world saved me from\ndanger and they put into the strange hole and\nreached here.
But now they might be in danger...\nI can't sit around!\nI must go back and help them...
Wait! Wait!!\nYou're injured! How can you save them?!
She's right! It's against the chivalry of Xmas\nKnights to throw life away!
B-But!!
It's alright.\nWe have a great help here!
You can't pretend not to see this situation!
I knew you would say so!
We met just now but... I'm sorry!\nI need your help!!
I appreciate it. The enemy is strong enough to\ndefeat and seal Xmas Knights even though they\nwere weakened. Please stay alert...
Leader Tenert!!
Ha ha, you've got beaten up. Are you alright?
I haven't fallen so low as to be worried by you...
Ha, you still got guts to talk back.
Hey guys. The guys are exhausted but they\nare not hurt. But is he alright?\nHe looked like seriously injured...
And thank you for saving the guys who fought\na lot to let Sir Agios escape here.\nThis is my thank-you gift.
My thanks to you for saving my lifesavers...\nHm? I contacted the sealed knights via spell but\nthere's no reply.
Without the Knights, Xmas may decline in other\nworlds... I've gotta go save them to continue\nprotecting Xmas!
You can beat him without Xmas energy or something?
U-Um...
Though Xmas energy was lost, one of the strongest\nKnights in Estagia was sealed except you.
You should be fully prepared before fighting\nthe Dark Knight. We have to start with supplying\nyour energy...
But there's no Xmas energy at that place.\nWhat should we do...?
Then, how about supplying it from Navida's Relics?\nIt's full of Xmas energy, right?
But if the energy of earth was supplied to Agios,\nNavida's Relics would get stuck again and become\nunable to go back to Estagia.
What?! Really?!\nI don't want it happen...
We still have an option. I can convert another\nenergy to Xmas energy and give it to Agios...
Sounds great! We can supply energy to Agios\nthat way without making Navida get stuck!!
Is that possible?!\nBut what's another energy...?
It's the energy of the heavens that can be\nconverted to Xmas energy like the energy of\nearth.
Hey, remember you collected the plants and\nconverted its energy to the energy of earth?\nCan you go collect like the last time? Please!!
Thank you sooo much!\nI'm counting on you.
I appreciate your help.\nI'll tell you what we need, okay?\nNow...
The spirit told the numbers and types of items\nneeded!
Remembered all of them?\nThanks in advance.
Wait, wait. I don't really understand what you\nguys are talkin' about but we'll help you.
I'm completely recovered, so I wanna do something\nback in return.
...Oh, right.\nWe can't leave the big ape to the people in here.
Yea. He keeps our hands always full and what is\nworse, he's injured.
Hey! I heard it!\nAm I making troubles to you?!
Always.\nHee hee. Okay. I'll take you up on that.\nBe careful on your way.

Welcome back. It was hard, isn't it?\nBut now we can generate the energy for Leader\nAgios. Thank you so much. This is for you.
Spirit, the adventurer has got the source\nof the energy of the heavens.\nLook, is this enough?
Thank you for your hard work.\nThis should be enough to supply Xmas energy to\nAgios.
I don't know how to say thank you enough for\nwhat you've kindly done to me...\nThank you.
Now, let's convert the energy source to Xmas\nenergy...
W-What the heck's goin' on?!
The newborn Xmas energy.\nFall to him as the light to destroy the evil!!
A-Amazing...
T-this is what you call Xmas energy?!
So, what he said was true...
The great spirit, I appreciate it.\nNow I can go help the knights...\nSee you later!
Wait. Though you've got back the power, we have\nno clues as to the knights' whereabouts, and you\nmay encounter the Dark Knight again.
...It's too reckless to go save them alone.\nI cannot permit it as the spirit of Navida...
But!! We've got no time to save all of...
I really hate to ask you for this since you've\nbeen doing so many favors for us but...\nCould you give a hand to Agios?
The great spirit, that's...!!
Yea! The adventurer should be tired.\nThen, I'd rather go instead of...
You are still novice...\nYou are inadequate.
Oh, you make no bones about it...
Then, we'll go!\nWe three should be as helpful enough as the\nadventurer is...
Mr.Tenert. You're not fully recovered.\nYou think you can fight as usual?
W-What...?!
Ms. Libera and Mr. Virgo, right?\nYou aren't completely recovered yet, are you?
Me?! I-I'm...
You've got me. You know everything...\nBut the adventurer must be exhausted, too.\nWe can't rely solely on the...
A-Are you serious?!\nWe're saying we'll go instead of you!!
Thanks...\nMay the energy of Xmas protect you...
Agghhh!! Don't blame me later!\nYou won't get any help even if you're beaten\nby the Dark Knight!!
Sorry, we shouldn't have been hurt like this...\nI'll leave the assistance for the knight to you.
I can't go with you. I'm so sorry.\nBut we'll stop monsters coming to here...\nYea,  good luck.
Heeeey! Stooop!!
*pant* ...Sorry for stopping you.\nTake this, won't ya?
Virgo held out a key to you.
You saw treasure chests in the fort, didn't ya?\n...Yea, that one! You saw some chests, right?\nThis can be the key for 'em.
Before we were confined in the ice cage, I took it\nwhile I was fighting the evil knight.\nBut I totally forgot it after the mess.
Now I can't go to the for, so why don't you get\nthe treasure instead of me? ...Huh? It's okay.\nThey're all yours. Don't mention it!
It's alright.\nI would waste all if I got 'em.
Okay! I'll leave the rest to you.\nDon't lose the key on your way.
You received a treasure chest key from Virgo!
...The knights aren't back even after defeating\nthe Dark Knight.\nSeems like it isn't that simple.
The knights' whereabouts should have something\nto do with the treasure that the Dark Knight left.\nWe need to investigate the fortress again.
But the adventurer and Agios look exhausted after\nthe fight with the Dark Knight. Let's have a rest\nand make plans later.
Well fought, adventurer!\nThanks for supporting our leader and finding\nthe knights' whereabouts. This is for you.
You're so strong enough to defeat the Dark Knight\nand his soldiers! But you're tired, aren't ya?\nWe should have a good rest today, right?
Tenert! I can tell you're planning to hold a\ndrinking party, aren't you? You can't do it\ncuz you are not fully recovered yet!
Oh, come on!
Oh, adventurer! I was waiting for you.
Hey, it's you! ...Hm?\nYea, look. I'm all better now thanks to the\ngreat spirit, Nicola, and... his help.
...So. We decided to give them a hand to save\nthe sealed knights in return.
Huh. Tenert never takes no for an answer once\nhe says he's going to do something...
We owe them a lot, so we'll cooperate with them.
So, we were about to go find the clues to the\nknights' whereabouts  at the fortress.\nCan you come with us?
Alright, let's go!
Wait, Agios. Only you and the adventurer have\nto go investigate the fortress. And come back\nimmediately when it's done.
Hey! What did you say?!\nThis is my first work as a Xmas Knight, you know?!
Please don't hesitate to ask us for help.\nYou've been a great help for us...
I mean... Agios, you're not fully recovered yet.\nYou seem alright to go investigate with the\nadventurer but...
If you are attacked by fierce monsters, you'll\nface a crisis. That's why I want you to come\nback at once after the investigation.
Certainly...
Then, we should go with them, shouldn't we?
I'd like to ask you a favor so Agios can gain\nenergy...
While they are investigating the fortress,\nCould you collect the energy of earth, which\ncan be converted to Xmas energy?
I'm okay with that but how can we get the energy\nof earth...?
I know!\nThe adventurer told me about it before!
Oh, right. Then, can you come with us and collect\nit together? That should be much faster.
Yeah!! Sir Agios, we'll collect a lot of the energy\nso you can gain more Xmas power.\nNever push yourself too much, okay?
Understood. Mr. Tenert, I would like to leave\nthe novice knight to you.
Watch your step.\nAlright! Let's go!!
Go to Fort Solfini now?
Yes!
Not Yet

You reported to the spirit about the mysterious\npattern and plinths that you saw at the fortress.
...The mysterious pattern on the ground and\nsix plinths... That reminds of people\ncalled Wizards in this world.
I've never seen Wizards but I heard some of them\ncan seal a dragon in a magic circle to extract\nthe energy of the dragon to cast spells...
A magic circle to seal a dragon?!\nIs that possible...?
If the pattern you saw is a magic circle, the\nXmas Knights might have been sealed as the\nsacrifices for the sealed dragon...
No!!
Then, all of them are eaten already?!\nHey! Leader! Adventurer!!
No. I don't think so...
Even if the Dark Knight has sent the knights\nto feed the sealed dragon, it won't eat them\nat once...
Dragons have high intelligence...\nThey understand that they would starve until the\nnext time if they ate them at once.
The dragon must be absorbing their energy.\nSo, they must be alive even though they\nare weakened!
